answer: The defence rests on jury service record with court summons history: summonses answered and service completed over several years. Forging 107 of these means building 107 separate jury records from scratch, and years of history cannot be bought in bulk. The inlet test is the price tag: 107 fakes mean 107 payments. Verification runs against the issuer's own registry every epoch, so a forged entry is caught on the next check. The vault signal is visible to every grader, and the willow ledger is what makes the farm's arithmetic fail.
